$comment: Map presets for the planner. The app must read map size ONLY from here. See docs/04-game-data-and-map-scale.md §1 before changing anything.

presets.label: Standard flat map

source.claim: Planet Zoo 1 sandbox/franchise maps measured by players at about 1000 x 1000 m (1 km²).
Planet Zoo 1 heightmap guide: 1024 x 1024 px heightmap corresponds to a 1000 x 990 m map.
Planet Coaster 2 maximum map size reported as 1 km x 1 km.

presets.notes: Default carried over from Planet Zoo 1 / Planet Coaster 2 evidence. No official Planet Zoo 2 figure has been published as of 2026-10-15. Verify in-game using the procedure in docs/04 §1.1, then set verified=true and fill verifiedOn/verifiedBy/method. If the game's buildable area is smaller than the visible map, set widthM/heightM to the BUILDABLE size.
